rules: docs/lotus-v2 consensus.md C14a, C14b, C16, C24, C25; decisions/resources-and-parameters.md (P05)
conventions: Amounts, costs above 2^53, E, work and index terms are decimal strings; sizes, counts and per-transaction cu are JSON numbers.

Every transaction pays exactly recommended_fee_atoms, so its change value and signatures differ per scenario. Signatures are BIP340 with zero auxiliary randomness by secret keys 1, 2, 3 and 4 (big-endian scalars).

Two indices: inputs.byte_fee_index prices the C14b byte fee (the state COINBASE_MATURITY blocks back) and inputs.cu_index the cu share (the block's own index, from its parent state, as in C25's L_tx). They differ only in the scenarios named 'byte I=..., cu I=...'.
base_cost_cu is the cost of the block already selected ahead of the transaction (P05 wallet policy); 0 unless the name ends in +base=N. block_alone ignores it.
Vectors with no `@` in their name use the scenario I=1,E=E_min.

formulas.fee_index: I = subsidy * genesis_work / (genesis_tail * parent_work); cu_index uses the block's own state, byte_fee_index the state COINBASE_MATURITY blocks back
formulas.byte_fee_atoms: v = ceil(min_fee_per_kb * size / 1000); N = floor(floor(v^2 * subsidy * genesis_work / parent_work) / genesis_tail); r = isqrt(N); byte_fee = r + (r^2 < N)
formulas.cu_share_atoms: P05 wallet policy: X = ceil(C_tx * max(E, E_min) / 2^linear_shift); N = floor(floor(X^2 * subsidy * genesis_work / parent_work) / genesis_tail); linear = r + (r^2 < N), r = isqrt(N); cuShare = 2 * linear + 2 * (Q_up(base + C_tx) - Q_floor(base)), cu_index
formulas.q_up_floor: e = max(0, C - E_min); Q_up(C) = max(ceil(C^2 / 2^quad_shift), ceil(subsidy * e^2 / E_min^2)); Q_floor the same with floors
formulas.two_floor_x_sqrt_i_atoms: P05's literal form 2 * floor(X * sqrt(I)), X = (C_tx * M) >> linear_shift (monetary.indexed_linear)
formulas.extra_underclaim_atoms: U_required(block_alone) - U_required(coinbase only): the subsidy the miner still burns to include this transaction

derived: invocation_charges_cu: the approved opcode charges of resources bound into a VMProfile here; the legacy-bridge P2PKH spend is charged one BIP340 check (SIG_BIP340), since P05 prices no bridge verification.
cu_share and recommended_fee_atoms: P05's wallet fee policy, computed here; the reference has no wallet-fee function.
